before.html:
Question 1
?

The vector u has magnitude 8, the vector v has magnitude 2, the angle between u and v is 100∘ and n is the unit vector that points in the direction of u×v. Find u×v in terms of n. Round your final answer to one decimal place where appropriate.

a
2.8n
b
15.8n
c
7.8n
d
7.9n
e
16.0n
Submit

decision.explanation: The cross product has magnitude |u||v|sin(100°) = 8·2·sin(100°) ≈ 15.8. Since n is its unit direction vector, u × v = 15.8n.

after.name: Question 1
after.problem: The vector $u$ has magnitude $8$, the vector $v$ has magnitude $2,$ the angle between $u$ and $v$ is ${100}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $u\times v.$ Find $u\times v$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to one decimal place where appropriate.
after.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|u|\cdot |v|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =8\cdot 2\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{100}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =16\cdot (0.984\,80…)\cdot n \\  & =(15.756\,92…)\cdot n \\  & ≈15.8n.\end{aligned}
$$

We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|u|\cdot |v|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =7\cdot 7\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{117}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =49\cdot (0.891\,00…)\cdot n \\  & =(43.659\,31…)\cdot n \\  & ≈43.7n.\end{aligned}
$$
